title: Representative-normalized comparison of ordinary tensor models
statement: For a prime l, a finite l-adic coefficient field E, a scheme X and a supplied RingedModels presentation d, there is a natural isomorphism from ConstructibleTensorModel.ordinaryTensor to d.tensor(X).ordinary.tensor whose component on every pair of good flat-term K-flat complexes carries tensorRepresentativeIso to the supplied ordinary representative. No invertibility of l on X is required.

source.place: Tags 07A4, 06YS and 0941; representative normalization step of lem-sf-tensor-reduction-augmentation

proof.text: Restrict the supplied ordinary representative to good complexes. Compose its natural isomorphism with the inverse of tensorRepresentativeIso. The good-complex localization and its product are localizations at quasi-isomorphisms. Mathlib fullyFaithfulWhiskeringLeft lifts the composite isomorphism. Evaluating map_preimage and cancelling the inverse representative gives the required equation.

from.place: Ordinary tensor model comparison in integral reconstruction

lean.statement:
theorem tensorRingedModelComparison (X : Scheme.{u})
    (d : IntegralSystemRealization.RingedModels l E) :
    ∃ e : ConstructibleTensorModel.ordinaryTensor l E X ≅ (d.tensor X).ordinary.tensor,
      ∀ P Q : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E X).FullSubcategory,
        (ConstructibleTensorModel.tensorRepresentativeIso l E X).hom.app (P, Q) ≫
          e.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj, DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q.obj) =
        (d.tensor X).ordinary.representative.hom.app
          (⟨P.obj, P.property⟩, ⟨Q.obj, Q.property⟩)
